brief:
An Israeli is attempting to sell a crescent finial allegedly taken from a mosque in Gaza's Rafah area, Middle East Eye reported. An Israeli rights group shared an image of the listing, documenting what it described as a purported architectural piece from a Gaza mosque.

The sale listing marks another instance of reported looting of cultural and religious property amid the conflict in Gaza, according to the rights group's account.
dek: Israeli puts 'Gaza mosque crescent finial' up for sale, rights group says An Israeli rights group has shared an image of an Israeli offering for sale a purported crescent finial from a mosque in Gaza's Rafah crossing.
title: Israeli offers Gaza mosque finial for sale, rights group reports
